news.headline: BlackRock discloses 7.1% beneficial stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: A Schedule 13G filing shows BlackRock has built a 7.1% passive beneficial ownership stake in ClearPoint Neuro, adding a major institutional holder alongside existing investors like MAK Capital.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results August 3, 2026
news.source: The Globe and Mail / ACCESS Newswire
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close on August 3, 2026, followed by a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: EpilepsyGTx partners with ClearPoint Neuro to support targeted delivery of lead gene therapy in epilepsy
news.summary: EpilepsyGTx will use ClearPoint Neuro's SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation system to administer its gene therapy candidate EPY201 in an upcoming first-in-human Phase 1/2a trial for focal refractory epilepsy, adding a new biopharma partner to ClearPoint's drug-delivery ecosystem.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro CEO Burnett sells $387,600 in company shares
news.summary: A Form 4 filing disclosed that CEO Joseph Burnett sold approximately $387,600 worth of ClearPoint Neuro common stock in early July 2026, coinciding with a pullback in the shares that day.

news.headline: B. Riley raises ClearPoint Neuro price target to $30 from $20, keeps Buy
news.summary: B. Riley analyst Anderson Schock raised his price target on ClearPoint Neuro to $30 from $20 while reiterating a Buy rating, citing the platform-validating implications of the FDA's stance on partner uniQure's AMT-130 program.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro shares surge as FDA clears accelerated-approval path for partner uniQure's AMT-130
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro shares jumped roughly 26-32% after partner uniQure disclosed that an FDA Type B meeting confirmed its three-year Phase I/II data can support a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, with submission planned for Q3 2026; AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro reports second-quarter 2026 results after market close with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET; investors will watch for progress toward full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $52M-$56M and updated commentary on the uniQure AMT-130 opportunity.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission for Huntington's disease
catalysts.detail: Following an FDA Type B meeting confirming that three-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA, partner uniQure plans to submit the filing in Q3 2026. AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula, making regulatory progress here a direct validation of ClearPoint's delivery-device business.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx first-in-human trial for EPY201
catalysts.detail: Under the July 2026 partnership, EpilepsyGTx plans to use ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation system to dose its EPY201 gene therapy candidate in an upcoming first-in-human Phase 1/2a trial for focal refractory epilepsy, another near-term proof point for ClearPoint's delivery platform.

catalysts.label: Continued partner pipeline execution and revenue guidance
catalysts.detail: Beyond uniQure and EpilepsyGTx, ClearPoint's device/navigation revenue is tied to a broad roster of 60+ biopharma partners' gene- and cell-therapy programs that use its SmartFlow and navigation systems; regulatory or clinical progress at these partners remains a recurring catalyst against the company's reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $52M-$56M.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro heads into its August 3, 2026 Q2 print on a wave of positive momentum: partner uniQure's June 17 FDA update clearing an accelerated-approval path for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease sent CLPT shares sharply higher and drove a B. Riley price-target hike to $30, while a July 14 partnership with EpilepsyGTx for its EPY201 epilepsy gene therapy adds another proof point for ClearPoint's navigation and SmartFlow delivery platform. BlackRock's disclosure of a fresh 7.1% stake underscores growing institutional interest even as CEO Joseph Burnett made a routine share sale in early July. With FY2026 guidance of $52M-$56M reaffirmed after 43% Q1 revenue growth, investors will watch the Q2 report for confirmation that the 60+-partner biopharma pipeline continues translating into device and navigation revenue growth.
